original_value: 27-inch QHD desktop display designed for color-accurate illustration and motion review, featuring an IPS panel, 2560 x 1440 resolution, 99% sRGB coverage, built-in dual 5W speakers, and USB-C DisplayPort alternate mode with 65W laptop charging. The matte graphite enclosure includes an adjustable stand, low-blue-light mode, and a factory calibration report for creative workflows.
